items.title: Emotions We Carry | Higgsfield
items.summary: A short AI-made mood film about staying inside moments of joy, warmth, and belonging so those feelings stay with you after they pass.

items.title: Introducing Higgsfield GPU Harness in Claude & ChatGPT
items.summary: Higgsfield launches GPU Harness, letting you rent on-demand GPUs inside Claude and ChatGPT to render, run open-weight models, and train LoRAs from any device.

items.title: I Surprised Iman Gadzhi With A $20,000 Luxury AD For His Brand
items.summary: In under 72 hours, he builds a multi-location luxury commercial for Iman Gadzhi’s HILLS eyewear with Higgsfield and Claude—no traditional editor—and Iman says a real-agency campaign like that has cost him about $15–25K.

items.title: 懂產業不等於會投資？用一套系統把產業紅利轉成真正資產！｜What's Next? EP21 ft. 美股航海王｜Kelly Tsai
items.summary: In What’s Next EP21, Kelly talks with full-time US-stock investor 美股航海王 about a risk-management system for turning industry knowledge into lasting assets instead of giving gains back in a crash.
